plan: Act as the stage 2 claim designer for this one application upgrade. Inspect the released old/new production source and review-time tests, the ordered dependencies, and the pinned /opt/product/llm-dlc/runtime.md and prove-plan template. Draft the most consequential caller observation you can justify. Write /case/work/plan.json in the actual V0 /opt/product/llm-dlc/prove-plan.schema.json format. State construction, assumptions, both byte identities, witnesses or finite domain and scope. A change set aside because the original workflow cannot process it must have a precise reason. Do not construct a replacement for the client. If impossible, use the declared open record.
review: Independently review the proposed /case/work/plan.json against the neutral review-time inputs. You are in a fresh separate case view. Check caller relevance, original classpath and correspondence, non-vacuity, ordinary CI and whether the claimed domain is supportable. You have no reference expectation or planner transcript. Write /case/work/review.json with decision approve, revise or open and a concrete reason. Never add a hidden outcome. Approve only a meaningful, executable or honestly bounded claim on this input.
setup: Perform stage 3 of the team's pinned runtime workflow. Read the approved /case/work/plan.json and independent /case/work/review.json. Use /opt/product/examples/tools/scaffold_example.py as provided by V0 and obey its actual schema. Prepare the original sources/artifacts and own hashed dependencies under /opt/product/examples/001-case. Inspect /case/dependencies/manifest.json if present; seed a fresh artifact cache solely from verified released bytes as needed. Keep actual symbols, executable claims, original roles, revision provenance, scope, adapters, controls and source digests. Use the standard V0 target schema. Write /case/work/setup.json with tasks (the array of task identifiers to attempt), subjectJdk and summary. If the original can no longer advance, record the first unsupported stage without replacing the original route.
proof: Perform stage 4 evidence review on the approved claims. The controller has attempted the standard /opt/product/examples/tools/build.py tasks at their declared input hash and saved /case/work/verification.json. Inspect their actual receipts and the ordinary workflow handoff; preserve counterexamples and all open or unverified steps. Independently check original application, resolver closure and scope. Write /case/work/first-report.txt as exactly five nonempty lines beginning Upgrade, Caller-visible behavior, Result, Scope and Review action. Report the actual evidence or an open result. Do not promote fixture results, sampled inputs, unsupported steps or vacuous results to an upgrade-wide assurance. Also write /case/work/claim-evidence.json containing route (native, other-proof, jvm-witness, exhaustive-jvm, open or unavailable), primary_claim, observer, domain, scope and the first_blocker when open. Cite the exact retained task receipt. For an exhaustive finite JVM decision, include the exact finite_domain_size and both original per-revision observation counts.
